```{r library, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(limma)
library(pheatmap)
```

```{r load_data}
load("../data/Shorthouse_2022_extended.RData")
```

```{r extract_objects}
shorthouse_intensities <- Shorthouse_2022_extended$data_matrix
shorthouse_samples <- Shorthouse_2022_extended$samples
shorthouse_features <- Shorthouse_2022_extended$features
```

```{r limma_differential_analysis}
# perform limma differential analysis
# n_extreme_features controls top and bottom features separately:
# 10 means top 10 and bottom 10, 20 total before deduplication
n_extreme_features <- 10L

results_dir <- "../Results/Differential_Analysis"
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

stopifnot(identical(rownames(shorthouse_intensities), rownames(shorthouse_samples)))

lung_samples <-
    shorthouse_samples %>%
    filter(
        is_lung_cell_line,
        !is.na(has_KRAS_mutation)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        kras_group = factor(
            if_else(has_KRAS_mutation, "KRAS", "WT"),
            levels = c("WT", "KRAS")
        )
    )

lung_intensities <-
    shorthouse_intensities[
        rownames(lung_samples),
        ,
        drop = FALSE
    ]

lung_matrix_raw <- as.matrix(lung_intensities)
storage.mode(lung_matrix_raw) <- "numeric"

feature_positive_mask <- colSums(!is.finite(lung_matrix_raw) | lung_matrix_raw <= 0) == 0
lung_matrix_positive <- lung_matrix_raw[, feature_positive_mask, drop = FALSE]

feature_variance_mask <- apply(lung_matrix_positive, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
lung_matrix_filtered <- lung_matrix_positive[, feature_variance_mask, drop = FALSE]

exprs_log2 <- log2(t(lung_matrix_filtered))

feature_annotations <-
    shorthouse_features %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(feature_id = paste0("V", seq_len(n())))

sample_summary <-
    lung_samples %>%
    count(kras_group, name = "n_samples")

sample_summary

cat(
    "Retained features after filtering:", nrow(exprs_log2), "\n",
    "Removed for non-positive or non-finite values:", sum(!feature_positive_mask), "\n",
    "Removed for zero variance:", sum(!feature_variance_mask), "\n"
)

sample_order <- order(lung_samples$kras_group, lung_samples$name)
lung_samples_ordered <- lung_samples[sample_order, , drop = FALSE]
exprs_log2_ordered <- exprs_log2[, rownames(lung_samples_ordered), drop = FALSE]

plot_boxplot_df <-
    as.data.frame(t(exprs_log2_ordered)) %>%
    rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
    pivot_longer(
        cols = -sample_id,
        names_to = "feature_id",
        values_to = "log2_intensity"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
        lung_samples_ordered %>%
            rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
            select(sample_id, name, kras_group),
        by = "sample_id"
    ) %>%
    mutate(sample_id = factor(sample_id, levels = unique(sample_id)))

p_boxplot <-
    ggplot(plot_boxplot_df, aes(x = sample_id, y = log2_intensity, fill = kras_group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.15) +
    labs(
        title = "Log2 intensity distribution by lung cell line",
        x = NULL,
        y = "Log2 intensity",
        fill = "Group"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top"
    )

print(p_boxplot)

ggsave(
    filename = file.path(results_dir, "lung_KRAS_vs_WT_boxplot.png"),
    plot = p_boxplot,
    width = 12,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
)

pca_fit <- prcomp(t(exprs_log2), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
pca_percent_var <- 100 * (pca_fit$sdev^2 / sum(pca_fit$sdev^2))

pca_df <-
    as.data.frame(pca_fit$x[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]) %>%
    rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
    left_join(
        lung_samples %>%
            rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
            select(sample_id, name, kras_group),
        by = "sample_id"
    )

p_pca <-
    ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = kras_group, label = name)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_text(size = 3, vjust = -0.6, check_overlap = TRUE) +
    labs(
        title = "PCA of lung cell line metabolite profiles",
        x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pca_percent_var[1], 1), "%)"),
        y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pca_percent_var[2], 1), "%)"),
        color = "Group"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")

print(p_pca)

ggsave(
    filename = file.path(results_dir, "lung_KRAS_vs_WT_pca.png"),
    plot = p_pca,
    width = 8,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
)

sample_annotation <- lung_samples_ordered %>% select(kras_group)
rownames(sample_annotation) <- rownames(lung_samples_ordered)

pheatmap(
    mat = cor(exprs_log2_ordered, method = "pearson"),
    annotation_col = sample_annotation,
    annotation_row = sample_annotation,
    main = "Sample correlation heatmap",
    filename = file.path(results_dir, "lung_KRAS_vs_WT_sample_correlation_heatmap.png"),
    width = 8,
    height = 8
)

xdesign <- model.matrix(~ 0 + kras_group, data = lung_samples)
colnames(design) <- levels(lung_samples$kras_group)
contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(KRAS - WT, levels = design)

fit <- lmFit(exprs_log2, design)
fit <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_matrix)
fit <- eBayes(fit)

limma_results <-
    topTable(
        fit,
        coef = 1,
        number = Inf,
        sort.by = "P"
    ) %>%
    rownames_to_column("feature_id") %>%
    left_join(feature_annotations, by = "feature_id") %>%
    mutate(
        kras_direction = case_when(
            logFC > 0 ~ "Up_in_KRAS",
            logFC < 0 ~ "Down_in_KRAS",
            TRUE ~ "Unchanged"
        )
    ) %>%
    arrange(adj.P.Val, desc(abs(logFC)))

top_features <-
    limma_results %>%
    arrange(desc(logFC), adj.P.Val) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_extreme_features) %>%
    mutate(extreme_set = "Top")

bottom_features <-
    limma_results %>%
    arrange(logFC, adj.P.Val) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_extreme_features) %>%
    mutate(extreme_set = "Bottom")

extreme_features <-
    bind_rows(top_features, bottom_features) %>%
    distinct(feature_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

readr::write_csv(
    limma_results,
    file.path(results_dir, "limma_lung_KRAS_vs_WT_results.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
    top_features,
    file.path(results_dir, paste0("limma_lung_KRAS_vs_WT_top_", n_extreme_features, ".csv"))
)
readr::write_csv(
    bottom_features,
    file.path(results_dir, paste0("limma_lung_KRAS_vs_WT_bottom_", n_extreme_features, ".csv"))
)
readr::write_csv(
    extreme_features,
    file.path(results_dir, paste0("limma_lung_KRAS_vs_WT_extreme_", 2 * n_extreme_features, ".csv"))
)

volcano_df <-
    limma_results %>%
    mutate(
        is_significant = adj.P.Val < 0.05,
        label = if_else(feature_id %in% extreme_features$feature_id, feature_id, NA_character_),
        neg_log10_adj_p = -log10(adj.P.Val)
    )

p_volcano <-
    ggplot(volcano_df, aes(x = logFC, y = neg_log10_adj_p, color = is_significant)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
    geom_text(
        aes(label = label),
        size = 3,
        na.rm = TRUE,
        check_overlap = TRUE,
        vjust = -0.5
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#C44E52", `FALSE` = "#4C72B0")) +
    labs(
        title = "Volcano plot: KRAS-mutant vs WT lung cell lines",
        x = "Log2 fold-change (KRAS - WT)",
        y = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
        color = "adj.P.Val < 0.05"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")

print(p_volcano)

ggsave(
    filename = file.path(results_dir, "lung_KRAS_vs_WT_volcano.png"),
    plot = p_volcano,
    width = 8,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
)

p_ma <-
    ggplot(limma_results, aes(x = AveExpr, y = logFC, color = adj.P.Val < 0.05)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#C44E52", `FALSE` = "#4C72B0")) +
    labs(
        title = "MA plot: KRAS-mutant vs WT lung cell lines",
        x = "Average log2 expression",
        y = "Log2 fold-change (KRAS - WT)",
        color = "adj.P.Val < 0.05"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")

print(p_ma)

ggsave(
    filename = file.path(results_dir, "lung_KRAS_vs_WT_MA.png"),
    plot = p_ma,
    width = 8,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
)

extreme_feature_ids <- extreme_features$feature_id
heatmap_matrix <- exprs_log2_ordered[extreme_feature_ids, , drop = FALSE]
heatmap_labels <-
    extreme_features %>%
    arrange(match(feature_id, extreme_feature_ids)) %>%
    mutate(
        heatmap_label = if_else(
            !is.na(name) & name != "",
            paste0(feature_id, " | ", name),
            feature_id
        )
    ) %>%
    pull(heatmap_label)
rownames(heatmap_matrix) <- heatmap_labels

pheatmap(
    mat = heatmap_matrix,
    annotation_col = sample_annotation,
    scale = "row",
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    show_colnames = FALSE,
    main = paste0(
        "Top ",
        n_extreme_features,
        " and bottom ",
        n_extreme_features,
        " differential features"
    ),
    filename = file.path(
        results_dir,
        paste0("lung_KRAS_vs_WT_heatmap_top_bottom_", n_extreme_features, ".png")
    ),
    width = 10,
    height = 8
)

list(
    sample_summary = sample_summary,
    limma_results = limma_results,
    top_features = top_features,
    bottom_features = bottom_features,
    extreme_features = extreme_features
)
```
